scoring_justification: Agent reports only median aggregate metrics; recomputing from raw per-conformer energies is infeasible in the verifier without rerunning the full computational pipeline. Use T0 threshold comparison to the paper's published values with monotonic tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold median metrics for MMFF94, GFN2, ANI-1ccx from Table 1 of the paper.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1, columns MARE, R², Spearman ρ.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Copied directly from the published values in Table 1.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported results, defining the reproduction benchmark.

outputs.description: Median accuracy metrics for MMFF94, GFN2, and ANI-1ccx against DLPNO-CCSD(T)/cc-pVTZ reference energies across 681 molecules.

output_contract.notes: The agent must report the three required methods. Additional methods are not scored. The hidden checker compares the reported median values against the paper's published reference values with appropriate tolerances.
